scripts.preinstall: node -e "require('child_process').spawnSync(process.platform === 'win32' ? 'del' : 'rm', ['-f', 'package-lock.json', 'yarn.lock'], {stdio: 'inherit'}); if (!/pnpm\//.test(process.env.npm_config_user_agent || '')) { console.error('Use pnpm instead'); process.exit(1); }"
scripts.build: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm -r --if-present run build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm -r --filter "./artifacts/**" --filter "./scripts" --if-present run typecheck
